name: Full-Stack Task Tracker Web App
description: Production-grade full-stack web application featuring SQLite storage, FastAPI REST API, and a modern Tailwind CSS interactive frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Database models persist tasks with id, title, completed status, and timestamp
FastAPI router provides GET /api/tasks, POST /api/tasks, and DELETE /api/tasks/{id}
Interactive single-page HTML/Tailwind frontend allows adding, viewing, and toggling tasks
Deterministic acceptance tests verify all endpoints using TestClient

slices.title: Database Layer (SQLite + Schema)
slices.description: Implement task database storage and query methods.

invariants: Database creates tables on initialization if missing

acceptance_tests.tests/test_db.py:
from app.database import TaskDB

def test_task_db(tmp_path):
    db = TaskDB(db_path=str(tmp_path / 'test.db'))
    t = db.add_task('Buy groceries')
    assert t['title'] == 'Buy groceries'
    assert t['completed'] is False
    tasks = db.get_tasks()
    assert len(tasks) == 1

slices.title: Backend REST API (FastAPI)
slices.description: Implement REST API endpoints and connect to database layer.

invariants: Returns 201 on task creation and 200 on task list

acceptance_tests.tests/test_api.py:
import os
from app.main import create_app

def test_api_routes(tmp_path):
    app = create_app(db_path=str(tmp_path / 'api.db'))
    from starlette.testclient import TestClient
    client = TestClient(app)
    resp = client.post('/api/tasks', json={'title': 'Deploy to Cloud'})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    data = resp.json()
    assert data['title'] == 'Deploy to Cloud'
    list_resp = client.get('/api/tasks')
    assert list_resp.status_code == 200
    assert len(list_resp.json()) == 1
